review_candidates.title: Network Engineer – Production Support
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description About the role: As a Network Engineer , you will be part of a collaborative Squad responsible for the day-to-day operations of Euroclear’s global and complex network infrastructure. You will analyze and troubleshoot issues, validate incoming requests, and implement solutions to ensure network stability and performance. You will help set up and maintain the production network infrastructure and support the configuration of network devices for project-related activities. Analytical
eligibility_evidence: Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Ways of working Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment, regardless of any aspect that makes them unique (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, disability, ...).
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This position requires strong expertise in LAN/WAN systems, Software Defined Networking (especially Cisco ACI), and network security. Qualifications & Skills Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent certifications in network technologies. Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. Proficiency with Cisco ISE, Cisco DNAC, Palo Alto, CheckPoint, F5, Infoblox, etc. Expertise in Cisco ACI. Group Technology Services operates its IT systems and IT services in such a way that, at an appropriate and benchmarked cost level, it can deliver the agreed levels of service to support the requirements of the business processes, for both normal operations and during disaster recovery.
